content.subject: Apparel fulfillment and return data
content.draft_text:
Hi Devin,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. We help operations teams automate manual, reconciliation-heavy processes.

Saw that ShipMonk opened an apparel-specific fulfillment center. I imagine keeping return data aligned with inventory records can become increasingly time-consuming.

We build bots that reconcile return data with inventory records and flag mismatches, reducing manual reconciliation effort.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
